title: Layouts
description: Dwindle, master and scrolling layout behaviour

options.label: Preserve split
options.description: Keep the split direction when windows are added or removed

options.label: Smart split
options.description: Choose the split direction by the pointer position inside the window

options.label: Split side
options.description: Which side new windows are placed on

options.label: Default split ratio
options.description: Initial size of the first window in a split. 1 means an even split

options.label: Smart resizing
options.description: Resize the nearest edge to the pointer instead of the bottom right

options.label: Split the active window
options.description: Split the focused window rather than the one under the pointer

options.label: Split width multiplier
options.description: Width bias used when deciding the split direction

options.label: Split bias
options.description: Which window of the split counts as first

options.label: Special workspace scale
options.description: Size of windows on the special workspace

options.label: Permanent direction override
options.description: Keep a manually chosen split direction instead of using it once

options.label: Precise window dragging
options.description: Drop dragged windows more precisely onto the hovered area

options.label: Single window aspect ratio
options.description: Force a lone window into an aspect ratio, as two numbers like 16 9. 0 0 disables

options.label: Aspect ratio tolerance
options.description: How much the window may differ from the aspect ratio before it is forced

groups.title: Master
groups.description: One main window with a stack

options.label: Main window size
options.description: Share of the screen taken by the main window

options.label: New window position
options.description: Where new windows are placed

options.label: New windows on top
options.description: Add new windows at the start of the stack

options.label: New window next to focus
options.description: Place new windows before or after the focused one

options.label: Main window side
options.description: Where the main window sits

options.label: Smart resizing
options.description: Resize the nearest edge to the pointer

options.label: Drop at cursor
options.description: Place dragged windows at the cursor position

options.label: Keep position
options.description: Keep the main window in place when it is the only one

options.label: Focus main on close
options.description: Focus the main window after closing a stack window

options.label: Allow small splits
options.description: Allow splitting the stack into narrow columns

options.label: Center threshold
options.description: Number of stack windows needed before the main window is centered

options.label: Fallback side
options.description: Where the main window sits when center orientation has too few windows

options.label: Center ignores bars
options.description: Center the main window on the full screen instead of the free area

options.label: Special workspace scale
options.description: Size of windows on the special workspace

groups.title: Scrolling
groups.description: Windows in a horizontal strip of columns

options.label: Column width
options.description: Default width of a column as a share of the screen

options.label: Scroll direction
options.description: The direction the strip of columns extends

options.label: Follow focus
options.description: Scroll the view to the focused column

options.label: Focus fit method
options.description: How the focused column is brought into view

options.label: Minimum visible part
options.description: How much of a column must be visible before the view follows

options.label: Fullscreen single column
options.description: Let a lone column fill the whole screen

options.label: Wrap focus
options.description: Moving focus past the last column continues at the first

options.label: Wrap column swapping
options.description: Swapping columns past the end wraps around

options.label: Column width presets
options.description: Widths the resize binding cycles through, separated by commas
